most_similar_reason: Candidate 7 shares the core plot almost point for point: a supreme god angered by human wickedness resolves to destroy mankind by flood, forewarns a single righteous hero who builds a wooden vessel and provisions it, rides out the deluge with his wife/family until the waters recede and the vessel grounds, gives thanks/offering to the god afterward, and then becomes the ancestor from whom the repopulated peoples and their lands descend.
least_similar_reason: Candidate 2 is only a bare note that a variously named creator god is worshipped in a river basin, offering no flood, no vessel, no repopulation, and no episodes at all to correspond with the target.
